description: This Kotlin source file defines classes, functions, and logic related to establishing and probing TLS configurations for gateway communication, including certificate fingerprint verification and SSL context setup.

classes.name: GatewayTlsParams
classes.description: Data class representing parameters for TLS configuration including requirements, fingerprint expectations, and flags for trust on first use (TOFU) and stable identifiers.

classes.name: GatewayTlsConfig
classes.description: Data class encapsulating SSL socket factory, trust manager, and hostname verifier for TLS connection setup.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeFailure
classes.description: Enum representing possible failure states when probing TLS fingerprint, such as unavailable TLS or unreachable endpoint.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeResult
classes.description: Data class containing the result of probing a gateway's TLS fingerprint, including the fingerprint and failure status.

methods.name: buildGatewayTlsConfig
methods.description: Builds a GatewayTlsConfig object using given parameters, setting up trust managers and hostname verification based on fingerprint expectations and TOFU policies.

methods.name: probeGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Establishes a TLS connection to a specified host and port to retrieve and fingerprint the server's TLS certificate, handling various failure scenarios.
